ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In $\odot C$, $m \angle HCG = 2x$ and $m \angle HCD = 6x + 28$, find $m\widehat{HD}$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a circle with C as the center; G, C, and D are on the same horizontal straight line, forming a diameter, and CG and CD are rays in opposite directions. Point H is at the upper left of the circle, and segment CH connects from the center of the circle to H; therefore ∠HCG and ∠HCD share side CH, and the other two sides, CG and CD, are opposite rays, so these two angles form a linear pair. Reasoning: It is known that m∠HCG = 2x and m∠HCD = 6x + 28. The sum of the angles in a linear pair is 180°, so 2x + (6x + 28) = 180, giving 8x + 28 = 180, 8x = 152, x = 19. Thus m∠HCD = 6(19) + 28 = 114 + 28 = 142. Because ∠HCD is a central angle and intercepts arc HD, m arc HD = 142.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot C$, $m \angle HCG = 2x$ and $m \angle HCD = 6x + 28$, find $m\widehat{HD}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: C is the center of the circle, G-C-D lie on one straight horizontal diameter, and ray CH goes to point H on the circle. Thus angles HCG and HCD share side CH, while CG and CD are opposite rays, so they form a linear pair. From the text, use m∠HCG = 2x and m∠HCD = 6x + 28. Set 2x + (6x + 28) = 180 to get x = 19. Then m∠HCD = 6(19) + 28 = 142. Since ∠HCD is a central angle intercepting arc HD, m arc HD = 142.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图显示一个以 C 为圆心的圆，G、C、D 在同一条水平直线上，形成一条直径，且 CG 与 CD 是方向相反的射线。点 H 在圆的左上方，线段 CH 从圆心连到 H；因此 ∠HCG 和 ∠HCD 共用边 CH，另外两边 CG 与 CD 是相反射线，所以这两个角构成线性对。推理：已知 m∠HCG = 2x，m∠HCD = 6x + 28。线性对角度和为 180°，所以 2x + (6x + 28) = 180，得到 8x + 28 = 180，8x = 152，x = 19。于是 m∠HCD = 6(19) + 28 = 114 + 28 = 142。因为 ∠HCD 是圆心角，截得弧 HD，所以 m弧HD = 142。
